answer: Each agent escrows a stake before earning anything, and payouts flow only to identities that keep it posted. Auditors roam the ledger like wind over dune sand, exposing footprints: wallets funded by the same source get clumped and slashed together. New agents pass a juniper-badge proof-of-personhood check at signup, so one operator cannot mint cheap clones. Each caught sybil burns its whole stake — turning vertex growth from free into a costly, losing trade.
